doc: A PolyFEM simulation of the cells of `bodies`, in this process (polyfem_sim.simulation). The mesh is cut to those cells and to the faces (2D: edges) of the selections the boundary conditions name; its frames are the displacement at each kept time step, in mesh units. The objects from `transformation` on go to PolyFEM as polyfem_sim.run passes them, and PolyFEM checks them.
The tags simulated, one body each; every other cell, the background too, is dropped. A cell may be in one body only.
Mesh-to-solver unit scale; a list: one per axis. transformation's scale, if set, replaces it.
PolyFEM's geometry transformation, merged over the scale: scale and translation only, since a rotation would turn the displacements.

PolyFEM's boundary conditions. An item of dirichlet_boundary, neumann_boundary, pressure_boundary or obstacle_displacements names its faces by "selection": {"region": expression, "filter": expression}, the boundary of region where the outside cell satisfies filter.
PolyFEM's initial conditions; an item's "id" may be a body's tag.
PolyFEM's contact settings, over polyfem_sim's defaults.
PolyFEM's time settings (tend, dt, integrator), over polyfem_sim's defaults.
PolyFEM's solver settings, over polyfem_sim's defaults.
PolyFEM's discretization settings, over polyfem_sim's defaults.
PolyFEM's output settings. paraview.skip_frame (default 1) keeps every skip_frame-th step as a frame. PolyFEM writes files only if this sets advanced.save_time_sequence.
